findings.problem: The hint's 'large public room... or hall' also fits el salón (salón de eventos, salón de fiestas), which is very common in Latin America, so the prompt has two right answers.
findings.fix: hint: room in a public building, as in 'waiting room' or 'operating room' (not salón)

back.es: room, hall (a large room in a building or home; also living room)
back.example: Wait for me in the waiting room.

note: The word "public" in the hint is what keeps this card apart from the "living room" card, so a new hint needs to keep that contrast.
